class.name: ViewportServer
class.brief_description: A registry of every [Viewport] and [Window] in the scene tree.

method.name: get_viewport_by_rid
method.description: Returns the registered viewport whose [method Viewport.get_viewport_rid] is [param rid], or [code]null[/code] if no viewport in the tree has this [RID].

method.name: get_viewport_count
method.description: Returns the number of viewports in the tree, windows included.

method.name: get_viewports
method.description: Returns every viewport in the tree, windows included, in the order they entered the tree. The root window comes first.

method.name: get_window_by_id
method.description: Returns the window whose [method Window.get_window_id] is [param window_id], or [code]null[/code] if no window in the tree has this ID. [code]0[/code] ([constant DisplayServer.MAIN_WINDOW_ID]) is the root window. Embedded windows have no window ID of their own and are never returned.

method.name: get_windows
method.description: Returns every [Window] in the tree, in the order they entered the tree. The root window comes first.

method.name: has_viewport
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param viewport] is registered, that is, inside the tree.

signal.name: viewport_added
signal.description: Emitted when [param viewport] (a [SubViewport], a [Window] or another [Viewport]) has entered the tree and was registered.

signal.name: viewport_removed
signal.description: Emitted when [param viewport] is about to leave the tree and was unregistered. It is still valid during the signal.
